purpose: TTV Studio training-source allowlist. This is a discovery and provenance registry, not permission to download every item in a collection.

sources.dataset_name: Wikimedia Commons — individually licensed image and video files
sources.license: Per-file only; allowlist CC0, Public Domain, CC BY, and CC BY-SA after metadata verification
sources.commercial_use_permission: Yes for allowlisted per-file licenses; CC BY/CC BY-SA require attribution and CC BY-SA has share-alike obligations.
sources.derivative_work_permission: Yes for allowlisted per-file licenses, subject to attribution/share-alike where applicable.
sources.count: Dynamic catalog; query-time count is recorded in acquisition manifests.
sources.resolution: Varies by original file; minimum 1280x720 video and 512px image quality gates apply.
sources.duration: Varies; training clips are 2–8 seconds after shot-aware processing.
sources.attribution_requirements: Store creator, source page, license URL and license text per item. CC0/public-domain attribution is retained as provenance even where not required.

sources.license: Generally U.S. Government public-domain material, but third-party material and NASA identifiers can have restrictions.
sources.commercial_use_permission: Conditional — do not auto-download; a reviewer must verify the individual asset and NASA media guidelines.
sources.derivative_work_permission: Conditional — verify individual asset and avoid implying NASA endorsement.
sources.count: More than 140,000 media items (catalog figure changes over time).
sources.attribution_requirements: Keep NASA source URL and credit line; do not use NASA insignia/logotypes as training targets without review.

sources.dataset_name: Internet Archive — item-level public-domain/Creative Commons media
sources.license: Per-item metadata only; archive hosting is not a license.
sources.commercial_use_permission: Conditional — only after reviewer verifies the original rights holder and an allowlisted item license.
sources.derivative_work_permission: Conditional — only after per-item license verification.
sources.attribution_requirements: Preserve original item page, creator, license URL, and reviewer decision.

sources.dataset_name: TTV Studio user-owned or expressly licensed media
sources.license: Written authorization or ownership record supplied by the uploader.
sources.commercial_use_permission: Only when the authorization explicitly permits it.
sources.derivative_work_permission: Only when the authorization explicitly permits it.
sources.attribution_requirements: Retain signed release/consent reference and asset provenance; do not store sensitive release documents in the public manifest.
